# C17 Tenants, roles and maker-checker

Group: Tenancy and governance. Phase: 2, 3, 5. Stories: 5. Size: 19 SP.

## Purpose

Run one studio for many banks, with shared content read-only to them and every publish approved by a second person.

## Read first

- `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`
- `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`
- `design/10-studio-functions.md`
- `schemas/pack.schema.json`
- `schemas/common.schema.json`
- `CLAUDE.md`, for the guard-rails and the common Definition of Done

## Depends on

- C01 Artefact store and naming

## Open decisions that touch this component

- D8: Artefacts as files in a repository per tenant.

A story MAY start before its decision closes if it isolates the choice behind an interface and says so in its plan.

## Success for the component

Functions F-26 and F-32 pass, and the isolation suite shows that no tenant can read or change another tenant's content.

## Stories

### C17-S1 Tenant model and workspace

Size: 5 SP. Phase 2. Branch: `story/c17-s1-tenant-model-and-workspace`.

**Story.** As a platform owner, I want each bank to work in its own tenant, so that one studio serves many banks.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`, `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`, `design/10-studio-functions.md`; `schemas/pack.schema.json`, `schemas/common.schema.json`.
- Done first: nothing in this backlog.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- A tenant has an id, a cluster list and the shared packs it has accepted; the tenant id is never part of an artefact name.
- Every read and write carries the tenant.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- Two tenants each author b.hook.pre-release-approval.v1 with different content and neither sees the other's.

### C17-S2 Roles

Size: 3 SP. Phase 3. Branch: `story/c17-s2-roles`.

**Story.** As a platform owner, I want the roles of Part 6 enforced, so that who may author and who may approve is not left to convention.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`, `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`, `design/10-studio-functions.md`; `schemas/pack.schema.json`, `schemas/common.schema.json`.
- Done first: `C17-S1`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- Shared designer, shared checker, bank designer, bank checker and service operations are enforced on every action.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- A bank designer is refused when editing any artefact outside scope b.

### C17-S3 Shared content is read-only to banks

Size: 3 SP. Phase 3. Branch: `story/c17-s3-shared-content-is-read-only-to-banks`.

**Story.** As a bank designer, I want to open shared content and be unable to change it, so that every bank runs the same definitions.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`, `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`, `design/10-studio-functions.md`; `schemas/pack.schema.json`, `schemas/common.schema.json`.
- Done first: `C17-S2`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- Shared artefacts open read-only for a tenant; clone into scope b is refused for anything but a hook's own blocks.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- An edit of uae.wps.wf.salary-file-out.v1 from tenant example-bank is refused with a reason that names the rule.

### C17-S4 Maker-checker and audit

Size: 5 SP. Phase 5. Branch: `story/c17-s4-maker-checker-and-audit`.

**Story.** As an auditor, I want every publish to have a maker and a different checker, so that no one person changes what runs.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`, `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`, `design/10-studio-functions.md`; `schemas/pack.schema.json`, `schemas/common.schema.json`.
- Done first: `C17-S2`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- Publish needs an approval by a different person with the checker role in the same tenant or in shared.
- The audit record holds who, what, when, the diff and the approval, and cannot be changed.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- A maker who tries to approve their own publish is refused, and the attempt is in the audit record.

### C17-S5 Isolation suite

Size: 3 SP. Phase 3. Branch: `story/c17-s5-isolation-suite`.

**Story.** As a security reviewer, I want a suite that tries to cross tenant boundaries, so that isolation is proven and not asserted.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/06-tenants-hooks-configuration.md`, `design/11-packs-and-governance.md`, `design/10-studio-functions.md`; `schemas/pack.schema.json`, `schemas/common.schema.json`.
- Done first: `C17-S3`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- The suite covers catalogue, search, tests, exports and audit for cross-tenant reads and writes.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- Every case of the suite is refused, and each refusal is logged.
